title: elect_time_master ignores has_gps gate
description: P3 (wave-5 review of worker6-hjot): rust/lichen-core/src/superframe.rs:261 elect_time_master ignores has_gps; the doc says GPS-equipped gateways 'don't participate in backbone election' but the function still elects a GPS candidate unless the caller filters. Pre-existing logic, newly visible now the module is public API. Fix: skip has_gps candidates in the election (or document caller-must-filter explicitly) + test.
